input.quote: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
input.rationale: Section 3(i) (p0042) is the only sourcing commitment binding us: we "shall order" a TrueLink credit report for every borrower submitted for underwriting approval through a System using the Interface. That is a 100%-of-requirements/sole-supplier commitment for credit reports in the Interface channel. Measured against the fallback, only the "defined product category" element is satisfied: the obligation runs for the initial one-year term and each automatic one-year renewal under Section 13 (p0078), so it is not capped at 12 months, and nothing ends it automatically if TrueLink misses the Section 3 service levels (response time, availability) or delivery/transmission dates — indeed TrueLink disclaims liability for the data transmitted. Full-term exclusive dealing with no performance-based exit is walk-away territory, so we propose the preferred position and simply make the order optional (a one-phrase change that leaves TrueLink's transmission duty and disclaimer intact). Mitigants noted but not curative: Section 2(a) (p0022) confirms we are "not obligated to utilize the License" and may use similar third-party software and services, and Section 14 lets us terminate on roughly a month's notice — but that requires giving up the whole service rather than exiting the sourcing tie on TrueLink's non-performance. Exclusivity elsewhere in the document (the non-exclusive licence to us in Section 2(a) and the nonexclusive Credit Data licence we grant in Section 8(d)) imposes no exclusivity on us and is left untouched.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.

proposal.summary: Convert the mandatory credit-report sourcing commitment in Section 3(i) into an option so Client has no sole-supplier obligation.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot commit to buy every credit report from TrueLink, so we have made that order optional; our position is no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on us. If TrueLink needs volume comfort, we could look at exclusivity for this category capped at 12 months and ending automatically on any service level or delivery failure.

ops.oldText: Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
ops.newText: Client may, but is not required to, order from TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
